name: piano-learner
description: Orchestration du monorepo (backend Python via uv + frontend Next.js)

scripts.setup: uv --directory backend sync --extra ml && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev:api: uv --directory backend run --extra ml uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.lint: uv --directory backend run ruff check . && uv --directory backend run ruff format --check . && npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.format: uv --directory backend run ruff format . && npm --prefix frontend run format
scripts.doctor: uv --directory backend run --extra ml python -m scripts.doctor
scripts.check:ml: uv --directory backend run --extra ml python -m scripts.check_ml_stack --models
